species: This result confirms that native HMET1 PylRS/tRNAPyl pairs incorporate BocK into proteins via genetic code expansion in H. volcanii.
sample_source: Therefore, we decided to use H. volcanii, a model halophilic euryarchaeon, as the chassis for functional characterization of the two PylRS/tRNAPyl pairs from HMET1.
strain: Mascot was set up to search the database including all cellular proteins of H. volcanii DS2, common pollution proteins, SAMP1-MoaE protein with BocK and 20 natural amino acids at G24 residue and SAMP1-MoaE protein with BocK, 3-I-Phe and 20 natural amino acids at G14 and G24 residue assuming the digestion with trypsin.
